affinePreservation.parentMatrices: Retained as full source object matrices; all 2,185 source parent matrices are orthogonal/no shear.

sky.scope: Physically generated atmospheric sky, not the source custom cloud shader. The exported analytic sun supplies direct light.

physicalFoliageAdaptation: Energy-conserving thin-leaf diffuse transmission; not native emissive shader parity.
